results.detail: scopeNote_he verified (single CM [CRM] used only by OLE DB sources/Lookup, EnableConfig=True + config file, no file/staging/DML, only business write = SDK update of gen_withdrawal, comments define only 3/14/15). summary_he: 'היא קובעת לכל בקשה סטטוס סיום (הסתיים / הסתיים חלקית / הסתיים – קיים פער) לפי סטטוסי ההיזון החוזר ...' is wrong for the state-10 (manual) flow: there the status is 3 by default and 15 on an amount gap; feedback statuses only filter selection and 14 is never set (manual main.cs:34-42). Also the written attribute gen_withdrawalfinishdate is not mentioned among the recorded values.

results.detail: Sums and min(valuedate) are aggregated per withdrawal over all 54/5 transactions of all funds of the request's customer account (join via gen_AccountNumber -> Gen_customeraccount -> Gen_fundmain -> gen_ftcurrentyear), window ft.gen_valuedate >= gen_datesenttothebank (auto) / gen_valuedate >= w.CreatedOn (manual); no direct link to the request. Consequence correctly stated conditionally; ownership of gen_datesenttothebank left unknown.

Auto: Fault -> ErrorBuffer.AddRow with ErrorDescription (main.cs:88-89) to output 'Error' which has no path (only path in the flow is OLE DB Source Output, DTSX:1193). Manual: loop handles only valid responses, no Fault branch (main.cs:74-86). Both: if response is null / lacks 'Responses' nothing is recorded and myEntities.Clear() runs. Requests not updated remain in state 8/10 and are re-selected only if they still meet the query. Correct.

title_he is the translation of the component name. short_he: state 8, 54/5 in account funds, valuedate not earlier than gen_datesenttothebank with NULL exclusion and hypothesis labels, partition requirement (non-NULL, not 5/6), 3 when all such partitions are 4 else 14, 15 on partial withdrawal with amount mismatch (generic 'אינו תואם'), dates/amounts recorded; flow_he[4] lists all five written attributes. All match.

[7] states the gap test as 'הסכום שנמשך בפועל (בשקלים שלמים) שונה מהערך Gen_withdrawalvalue' - it specifies the truncation but omits the absolute value. Code: Math.Truncate(Math.Abs(gentranstotalamount)) != Math.Truncate(Math.Abs(Genwithdrawalvalue)). Without Abs, a negative transaction sum of -1000 vs a requested 1000 would read as 'different' while the code treats them as equal. Also: [1] 'האחרות נשארות פתוחות' labels state 8 as 'open', a meaning taken from the component name 'get open withdrawal' without a השערה label (detailed says correctly 'נשארת במצבה'); [12] omits gen_withdrawalfinishdate from the written attributes. Note: 'בשקלים' assumes the currency; other packages set a currency name 'שקל חדש' (e.g. 0008:85554) but nothing ties it to these fields - prefer 'ביחידות שלמות (Math.Truncate)'.

wrongUnits.correct: ... בתאריך המשיכה בפועל ובתאריך סיום המשיכה (שניהם תאריך הערך המוקדם, ToLocalTime), בסכום שנמשך בפועל ובסכום נטו.

results.detail: Every step re-derived: population gen_currentstate = 8; join chain and 54/5 filter; ft.gen_valuedate >= gen_datesenttothebank with NULL semantics and unknown ownership; sums with ISNULL and min(ft.gen_valuedate), GROUP BY w.Gen_withdrawalId, Gen_withdrawalvalue; partitions not in(5,6) (NULL excluded), min/max status, min(+0) flags; INNER JOIN trans/flpart; default 14, 3 if min=max=4, partial-withdrawal test with Abs+Truncate and ISNULL(...,0) -> 15 overriding; write of 5 attributes with ToLocalTime in tech; batches of 1000; fault/empty-response handling; unconnected Error output. results.detail: [2] and [3] correct. [1] meaning 'תנועה ... מיום יצירת הבקשה ואילך' turns the condition gen_valuedate >= w.CreatedOn into a day-level test. CreatedOn is a full datetime; a transaction whose value date falls on the creation day but whose stored datetime is earlier than the creation time (e.g. 00:00 vs creation at 10:00) is excluded by the SQL, whereas 'מיום ... ואילך' includes the whole creation day. The detailed claim states it correctly ('אינו מוקדם ממועד יצירת הבקשה').

wrongUnits.problem: Datetime comparison rendered as day-granular 'from the creation day onward'.
wrongUnits.correct: בקשה במצב 10 שנרשמה לחשבון שלה תנועה מסוג 54/5 שתאריך הערך שלה אינו מוקדם ממועד יצירת הבקשה (השוואת תאריך ושעה מלאים).
